verdict.summary: Round 3 finds no new correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect. The exact-set fix approved in round 2 remains present: open_object requires the separately supplied root to be the identical envelope indexed by its block ID, then traverses that indexed root. The focused regression test non-vacuously covers both an absent-root replacement with preserved chunk_count and a same-ID/different-envelope substitution. The implementation remains consistent with the design record's randomized block IDs, encrypted Merkle chunking, canonical encrypted-root CommitId, and duplicate-position rejection, while the public documentation keeps the research-grade, not-externally-audited sq-qhy4 caveat explicit.
